title: SD-MT341-TestHarnessAndFixtureTranslation
clause: Translate PostgreSQL-wired integration tests, fixtures and developer provisioning to real disposable SurrealDB.

scope.summary: GOAL: Translate PostgreSQL-wired integration tests, fixtures and developer provisioning to real disposable SurrealDB. This contract implements Master Spec v02.205. PostgreSQL, PgPool, sqlx-postgres, PostgreSQL SQL/DDL/RLS/LISTEN-NOTIFY/JSONB/pgvector and DATABASE_URL are forbidden as product-runtime authority. EventLedger semantic contracts remain authoritative but their persistence is SurrealDB-native. The current PostgreSQL database contains no valuable live information; no PostgreSQL connection, import, fallback, or proof path is allowed.
forbidden_paths: SQLite authority, cache, fallback or proof paths
acceptance_criteria: Every current PostgreSQL-wired product, fixture, launcher, installer and test surface is inventoried at the pinned product commit and each is translated to SurrealDB or retired with a recorded reason; brittle historical hit counts are not acceptance proof.
Test helpers provision unique SurrealDB namespace/database scopes, authenticate as the correct record user for privacy tests and clean up exact scoped targets.
No Docker/PostgreSQL service is a mandatory product or proof dependency; test configuration is quiet, bounded and Windows-safe.
Former PostgreSQL-specific targets and environment variables are renamed to semantic or SurrealDB names and CI/local commands exercise the same acceptance behavior.
proof_targets: Run the named focused Rust tests against a real disposable Handshake-managed SurrealDB namespace/database.
Run repository tripwires for PostgreSQL/sqlx/PgPool/PostgresDatabase and classify every remaining hit as historical documentation or a removal target; no connected legacy path is allowed.
Run with a scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-cargo-target/ and retain measured output outside the repo.
expected_tests: Every current PostgreSQL-wired product, fixture, launcher, installer and test surface is inventoried at the pinned product commit and each is translated to SurrealDB or retired with a recorded reason; brittle historical hit counts are not acceptance proof.
Test helpers provision unique SurrealDB namespace/database scopes, authenticate as the correct record user for privacy tests and clean up exact scoped targets.
No Docker/PostgreSQL service is a mandatory product or proof dependency; test configuration is quiet, bounded and Windows-safe.
Former PostgreSQL-specific targets and environment variables are renamed to semantic or SurrealDB names and CI/local commands exercise the same acceptance behavior.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/data migration contract; operator surfaces are consolidated in MT-345.

risk_if_missed: A remaining PostgreSQL physical assumption can create a hidden second authority, false completion proof, privacy bypass, replay divergence or runtime startup dependency.

risks: A PostgreSQL path survives behind a feature flag, fixture, direct pool consumer or fallback.
A root/system SurrealDB session makes privacy tests pass while bypassing record permissions.
EventLedger or projection behavior changes during physical-store translation.
A hidden PostgreSQL connection, feature, fixture or proof path survives the pivot.
minimum_controls: Compile and runtime tripwires plus exhaustive classified source inventory.
Privacy proof uses authenticated record users and ResourceBroker, never administrative credentials.
Real-runtime atomicity, replay, restart and reconciliation proofs.
Zero PostgreSQL connectivity, dependencies, runtime modes, fixtures or proof targets; fresh SurrealDB initialization is the only authority path.

research_provenance.source: Official SurrealDB Rust SDK, permissions/RLS, live-query and SurrealKit rollout documentation checked 2026-08-15; project product-code and completed-packet audits recorded in WP017 refinement.
research_provenance.selected_approach: Handshake-managed SurrealDB, official Rust SDK, SCHEMAFULL typed records, record-user permissions plus ResourceBroker, live queries, SurrealKit rollouts, preserved EventLedger semantics.
rejected_options: Re-labeling historical PostgreSQL validation as SurrealDB proof
